sources.prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION transparent pixel art character animation spritesheet for a polished 2D JRPG cinematic. This is an asset export, not a mockup. The reference is Regent Aldric's approved portrait: brown swept hair, clean-shaven, warm brown eyes, deep navy travelling coat with subtle antique gold trim and brown leather straps, cream shirt. No crown, no armor. Full-body natural adult proportions (head about 1/6 body), excellent hand/leg anatomy. Crisp intentional pixel clusters and limited painterly pixel shading matching 16/32-bit HD pixel cinematics, no antialiasing or blur. Every sprite must be isolated on TRUE transparent alpha with NO floor, NO shadow, NO labels, NO cell lines, NO text. Strict aligned 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW sheet, equal cells, full figure inside every cell with a large empty margin. All soles on a common horizontal baseline within each row. Camera is side/three-quarter side, consistent height. No sprite overlaps its cell.

ROW 1 contains ALDRIC in four cells, facing LEFT:
1 relaxed standing with hands naturally at sides
2 listening, head inclined slightly toward someone shorter, hands relaxed
3 restrained conversational gesture with one hand open low around waist level
4 WALK LEFT contact A, left foot forward/right foot back, opposing arms, natural modest stride.

ROW 2 also ALDRIC facing LEFT, same exact clothes and proportions:
1 WALK LEFT passing A, back leg comes under body and front leg supports weight
2 WALK LEFT contact B, right foot forward/left foot back, opposed arms
3 WALK LEFT passing B, opposite foot under body
4 STAND RIGHT facing right, arms at sides, same design.

ROW 3 is the SAME village GUARD in all cells: practical muted slate-blue tunic, leather belt, simple silver open-faced cap, brown boots, small wooden spear held vertically away from body. Not ornate armor:
1 stand facing RIGHT; 2 gesture to admit visitors with his free hand to right; 3 step RIGHT contact A; 4 step RIGHT contact B. Safe spear stays in his near hand.

ROW 4 different supporting travelers:
1 middle-aged CLERK facing LEFT, dark moss travel coat, brown hair, holding closed ledger at hip;
2 SAME clerk facing LEFT reading OPEN ledger at waist, natural elbows;
3 DRIVER facing LEFT, older weathered man, short dark beard, brown cap and earth-brown plain travelling clothes;
4 LOCAL facing RIGHT, working farmer in rolled cream sleeves, muted rust vest and brown trousers, hands at sides.

Keep everyone grounded, realistic length limbs, no exaggerated feet or fingers. Aldric should be recognizable from the portrait at a glance. No weapons for Aldric. All16 full bodies must be individually separable.

Create a transparent production HD PIXEL ART spritesheet matching the supplied JRPG pixel references. Four columns and four rows of equal cells, STRICT aligned16cells. Fully transparent alpha outside isolated art. NO grid lines, NO words, NO labels, NO scene, NO floor, NO shadows. Crisp intentional pixel clusters, warm nuanced colors, natural anatomy. Do NOT copy the tiny body proportions of the references; adult full figures should have a head one-sixth of full body, hands reach mid-thigh and knees halfway down legs. All figures full-length and centered in their own cell, same baseline, wide empty margins; every sprite fits. SAME CAMERA side/threequarter profile as the provided travelers spritesheet.

ROW1 Mother SERENE, recognizable from approved portrait: warm brown hair in a tidy bun, kind face, muted teal-blue shoulder mantle and cream ankle-length modest dress, brown belt/shoes.
1 stands facing LEFT with back three-quarter toward camera, one hand gently resting at waist as she looks through an implied window (no window drawn).
2 same person facing RIGHT in a relaxed standing pose, warm expression.
3 same person mid-turn from left to right, hands close to body, dress and feet naturally turning together.
4 walks RIGHT with one foot forward and opposite arm swinging modestly.

ROW2 TOMAS, recognizable from approved portrait: tousled blond hair, 14-year-old slim teenager, shorter than Serene, rusty red vest over cream shirt, brown trousers and shoes.
1 faces LEFT holding two simple plain cups near waist, bent elbows natural.
2 same pose, raises one cup a few inches to ask a question.
3 stands LEFT with hands relaxed at sides.
4 walks LEFT carrying the cups with a small careful step, no floating limbs.

ROW3 Supporting travelers matching the first reference spritesheet:
1 the older bearded DRIVER in brown cap and earth-brown coat SEATED facing LEFT, knees naturally bent at90degrees, both hands forward holding reins; draw only the driver, no bench, horse or wagon, give the entire seated body empty margins.
2 same DRIVER walks LEFT contact A with arms opposed to feet.
3 same DRIVER walks LEFT contact B, opposite feet forward.
4 the LOCAL young brown-haired farmer in cream rolled sleeves, rust vest, brown trousers, facing RIGHT with an open-handed low conversational gesture.

ROW4 four72px-style DIALOGUE PORTRAIT BUSTS (head and shoulders occupying cell with clear margins), FRONT-THREEQUARTER, no frames:
1 GUARD: adult brown hair, simple silver open-face helmet, slateblue tunic and brown leather shoulderstrap.
2 LOCAL farmer: young brown hair, rust vest and cream shirt.
3 CLERK: middleaged brown hair, darkmoss coat and cream collar, quiet attentive face.
4 DRIVER: older weathered face, shortdarkbeard, browncap and earthbrowncoat.
Portrait faces and outfits must match the supporting sprites in the supplied travelers reference. All art natural and friendly, subtle restrained acting. No magic, no weapons except no spear for portraits. Transparent background mandatory.

Production sprite animation sheet for a polished HD pixel art JRPG cinematic. Strict2 COLUMNS by2 ROWS of FOUR equal spacious cells, wide landscape sheet. Each cell contains the SAME horse and wagon viewed directly FROM THE LEFT SIDE, facing LEFT, fully visible, isolated on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha. No labels, text, guides, grids, scenery, ground, shadows or people. No rider or driver baked into the wagon.

DESIGN: one sturdy chestnut brown horse with dark mane facing LEFT at the LEFT end, harnessed naturally with brownleather tack and shafts to a modest practical weathered wooden four-wheel provisionwagon to the RIGHT. Clear enough open space above the wagon front driver's bench for a separately animated driver. A cream/beige canvas half-cover over wooden loadbed, neatly secured burlap sacks, a little muted-blue tied cloth, a few supplycrates. No fancy royal carriage, no gold, no weapons, no banners, no circus; this is a tired relief caravan. Wagon front is immediately behind horse, the bench above the frontwheel; rear is to theright. Correct realistic wheel/axle/body/harnessconstruction; same wholevehicle proportions acrossallfourframes. Pixeltexture detailed but clean intentionalclusters, sharpedges, limitedwarmbrowns/creams/charcoal. Match the supplied humanoid pixelart level, no blurry photography, no glossyrender.

FOUR frames of a slow natural horse WALK LEFT:
TOP LEFT contactA: near foreleg forward, opposite hindlegforward, otherfeetback.
TOP RIGHT passingA: weight on supportfeet, swingingfeet pass beneath body.
BOTTOM LEFT contactB: opposite foreleg/hindlegforward.
BOTTOM RIGHT passingB: reverse ofpassingA.
Natural four-beat walking anatomy with correct leg lengths; no galloping, jumping, extra legs or floating hooves. Allfeet share a baselineineachcell, horseandwagon stayexactlythe sameheight andwidth andregisteredcenters. Wagonwheels subtly rotate betweenframes, wagon bedstablewithatmostonepixelbounceatnativeexport. Tail changes slightly. Keep plenty transparent margin sohorseears, nose, tail, shafts andallwheelsneverclip. Allfour COMPLETE train sprites, notseparatehorseparts. The image should be a4frameasset library foranimation, no scene or UI.

Create a strictly aligned 4COLUMN x2ROW transparent pixelart WALK ANIMATION sprite sheet for two alreadydesigned characters. Exact characterdesigns fromthe supplied sources, no newclothes, no redesign. Each of8fullbodyfigures occupies equal cell, baselines aligned withinrow, huge transparent gutters. TRUE alpha, no grid, text, labels, scenery, floor or shadows. Natural adultproportions, crisp detailed pixelclusters, not a blurryillustration.

ROW1: SAME GUARD seen in thirdrowofthe firstreference, simple silveropenhelmet, slatebluetunic, brownbelt andboots. Allfourframes face RIGHT in exactlysame sideview. He holds a vertical spear in SAME NEAR LEFT HAND for ALLFOURFRAMES: spearshaft stays at LEFTSIDEofbodyinimage, freeRIGHTARMswings. The spear does NOT swap hand, does NOT jump to otherbody side, hand stays wrappedaroundshaftatwaist, tip wellabovehead, buttnearbootsole. Frame1 WALKRIGHT CONTACTA with nearfootforward; frame2 PASSINGA feetpassunderbody; frame3 CONTACTB oppositefootforward; frame4 PASSINGB. Good natural four-beatwalk; consistent spearpixelposition relativetorso andsameconsistent torso/helmetacrossallfour. Spear heldsteadyaslegsstep. Avoidsquatting.

ROW2: SAME MOTHER SERENE seen infirstrowofsecondreference, brown hairneatbun, mutedteal-blue shoulder mantle, creamanklelengthdress, brownbelt andshoes. Allfourframes face RIGHT in exactlysame sideview. Natural gentle walk right: contactA, passingA, contactB, passingB. Hands have modest opposed swing, dresshem andbootsmove naturally; noextremelegstride, no extrafoot, no armstretch. Her head/torso do not unnaturally change length. Characterstandingheightuniformacrossframes. Faithful fullfigures in allcells no croppedtoes. No portraits. Onlyeightisolatedanimationframes withcalmacting.

Create a transparent production PIXEL ART sprite animation sheet for the supplied JRPG cinematic characters and wagon. Strict 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS of eight isolated sprites with large transparent margins, evenly spaced. No labels or text, no floor, no scenery, no shadow, no gridlines. TRUE alpha background. Rich detailed crisp pixel clusters, natural body/horse anatomy, exact faithful navy/brown/cream colors from references.

CRITICAL CAMERA: We are BEHIND the subjects, looking at their BACKS as they walk AWAY FROM THE VIEWER, NORTH/upward toward the top of the image. Absolutely NOT the left-side profile of the reference. Clearly show the REAR of wagon and BACK of Aldric's head/coat. Do not make a side profile or diagonal sideways cartoon. This is needed for travelling THROUGH A NARROW GATE away from camera. Narrow rear silhouettes.

TOP ROW four animation frames of the SAME provision horse-wagon seen FROM BEHIND, moving AWAY NORTH. Weathered wooden wagon rear tailboard nearest viewer at bottom, two rear wheels visible to left and right, cream canvas cover with open rear edge and sacks, a hint of chestnut horse ears/head seen farther beyond front of wagon at upper center. Four-wheel wagon one horse, slim rear perspective. Brown-capped DRIVER is seated on FRONT bench FACING AWAY, back of head and brown coat visible at upper center near horse; driver is correctly integrated into this rear view, no sideface. Horse legs and tail make subtle alternating walking motion in four consecutive frames. Wheels rotate gently and same practical wagon stays the same narrow rear dimensions. Natural perspective: rearwardclosest wagon rear has widerwheelbase, horse ahead fartheraway is narrower. Entire horsewagon silhouette should be about 0.8 times as wide as high, not a broadside; all components fit in cell. Horse and driver are partly hidden by canopy realistically. Four consecutive walk frames maintain precise sprite size/registration.

BOTTOM ROW four animation frames of SAME ALDRIC seen FROM BEHIND walking AWAY NORTH, matching provided portrait/body reference. Brown swept hair backofhead, navy long travellingcoat with understated gold hem/trim and brown leather shoulderstrap, darktrousers, brownboots. No crown, no armor, no sword. Natural adult proportions head1/6height. Back-facing walking cycle frames contactA, passingA, contactB, passingB, restrained opposite arm movement, feet alternate naturally with smallverticalmotion. FACE NEVER VISIBLE, backofheadandnavycoatbackvisible. Allfour bodies sameheight, samebase andgoodlimblengths, no huge strides.
All eight COMPLETE sprites isolated on transparent with consistent nativegamepixelstyle.

Edit this existing transparent JRPG sprite sheet, preserving ALL character identities, pixel style, colors, layout, four-column/two-row structure, wagoncover, cargo, wheels and driver. The bottom row of Aldric sprites must remain unchanged.

Fix ONLY the FOUR TOP-ROW REAR WAGON SPRITES' horse occlusion. We are behind a wagon looking ahead toward its horse. The horse is AHEAD OF THE WAGON and its BODY, TAIL AND LEGS must be OCCLUDED by the solid wooden wagon chassis and cargo. Currently brown horse legs and white hooves incorrectly dangle down directly under the wagon's REAR axle toward the viewer. DELETE those visible HORSE LEGS, HOOVES AND TAIL under all four rear wagon bodies. Under the rear cargo tailboard there should be only the dark wooden/metal rear axle with open transparent air down to the ground plane, flanked by the TWO REAR WHEELS. NO dangling brown limb, NO white hoof, NO horse tail emerging from rear tailboard. The lowest ground contact is ONLY the wagon wheel bottoms, matching a level ground. The horse's ears/head may remain subtly visible far ahead ABOVE/BEYOND the front canopy near upper center, with the brown-capped driver's back nearer the bench, but NOTHING of the horse should stick below or through the rear wagon.

Retain the rear wood panels, two wheels, cream canvas, tied sacks, muted blue fabric, proper rear perspective, slim tall silhouette and exact pixel colors. Retain four animation cells and top/bottom row layout, all fully isolated on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, no painted backdrop, ground, text, labels or shadows. Preserve bottom-row Aldric animation exactly.
